title: An open-label phase II trial to evaluate the clinical efficacy, safety and tolerability of MAS825 in pediatric and adult participants with Still’s disease
official: An open-label phase II trial to evaluate the clinical efficacy, safety and tolerability of MAS825 in pediatric and adult participants with Still’s disease
summary: Main objective: To evaluate the efficacy of MAS825 on disease activity in participants with Still’s Disease
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Age ≥ 1 with a diagnosis of Still’s disease
2. Active disease
3. Need for glucocorticoids (prednisone or equivalent)
Exclusion criteria:
1. Ongoing or previous treatment with immunomodulatory drugs as outlined in the protocol’s   Prohibited therapies section, except a limited number of patients that have previously received MAS825 through a managed access program.
2. Absolute neutrophil count < 500/mm3
3. Glucocorticoid dose exceeding a certain threshold or requiring IV pulsed glucocorticoid therapy
4. Any conditions or significant medical problems which, in the opinion of the investigator, places the patient at unacceptable risk for MAS825 therapy.
5. History of ongoing, chronic or possibly recurrent infection(s) (e.g. HIV, TB, HCV, HBV) and/or symptoms and signs, in the judgement of the investigator, of clinically significant active bacterial, fungal, or viral infections.
6. Live vaccinations within a certain period prior to MAS825 treatment.
7. History of malignancy of any organ system, including post-transplant lymphoproliferative disorder (other than adequately treated localized basal cell carcinoma of the skin or in situ cervical cancer), treated or untreated, within a certain period, regardless of whether there is evidence of local recurrence or metastases.
8. History of hypersensitivity to any of the study drugs or to drugs of similar chemical  classes or to any of the excipients.
9. Pregnant or breastfeeding women
10. Women of child-bearing potential who do not agree to comply with required contraceptive use.
